sources.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
sources.repo_observation: As observed 2026-08-27, repository contains README/figures and states code will be available soon; executable implementation is not yet public.

sources.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis

adaptive_validation.text_classification_protocol: 20 evolution iterations, 3 candidate harnesses per iteration, 60 candidates total; separate train/validation/test splits.
adaptive_validation.terminal_bench_boundary: The same 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks are used for search and final evaluation; this branch is not an untouched outer-test result.
adaptive_validation.interpretation: Adaptive task allocation can reduce fixed-subset overfitting and evaluation cost, but its partial-set estimator is too noisy to treat as a behavioral certificate, especially at low sampling rates.

strategy_lock_in.experience_scaffold: Persistent experiment journal + skill/library context + evaluator guidance materially improves execution (+12.6 points on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval in reported runs) but does not reliably reopen the training strategy.
strategy_lock_in.human_guidance_boundary: Binding pre-training human guidance can redirect the initial strategy, but after training starts the agent returns to within-strategy local adjustment loops.
strategy_lock_in.compute_boundary: On AIME 2025, the richer scaffold used about 7.9x baseline tokens while yielding almost no robust gain; extra compute was spent on denser refinement inside the locked strategy.
strategy_lock_in.interpretation: Execution-level adaptation and strategy-level reopening are distinct control problems. A statistically careful acceptor can still optimize inside the wrong proposal family if no mechanism ever reopens the strategy choice.

separate_controls: evaluation-allocation controller: choose informative tasks efficiently but do not certify promotion
candidate acceptor: certify incumbent-vs-candidate evidence under repeated observation
strategy-reopening controller: explicitly decide when accumulated evidence warrants changing proposal family / training paradigm
outer evaluator: remain unused by proposal generation, acceptance, rollback, routing and stopping
required_logging_for_adaptive_validation: task inclusion probabilities for every evaluated candidate
estimated score and full-set calibration audit when available
selection decision and next-proposal feedback payload
design_contract.non_claim: Task-CoEvolve is evidence for evaluation-budget allocation, not for anytime-valid promotion safety. The post-training study is evidence for strategy lock-in, not a demonstrated strategy-reopening intervention.

preregistered_next_experiment.goal: Measure whether cheaper adaptive screening and explicit strategy reopening improve long-run self-improvement without weakening promotion validity.

evaluation_allocation: variance-weighted adaptive sampling with sampling-aware estimator

controls: same base model and harness mutation budget
same candidate/proposal compute within matched arms where causal comparison requires it
fresh outer test never queried by search, acceptance, rollback, routing or early stopping
separate reporting of execution-level edits and strategy-level changes
complete proposal chronology and task-sampling chronology
primary_failure_modes: false promotion from noisy partial evaluation
search stagnation inside a suboptimal strategy family
outer-test leakage through selection or stopping

frontier: Find a real >10-proposal LLM self-improvement system that combines adaptive evaluation allocation or another compute-efficient screen with candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, durable cross-proposal statistical spending, an explicit strategy-reopening mechanism, complete proposal/evaluation chronology, immutable promotion identity and an untouched outer test. If none exists, seek a replayable system where these components can be composed under matched proposal sequences.
